Indian tourists killed in Vietnam boat capsize

A tourist boat carrying Indian nationals capsized near Phu Quoc Island in Vietnam, resulting in the deaths of 15 people. Several other individuals were reported missing. The incident occurred shortly after the vessel departed, with some accounts suggesting it overturned approximately 300 meters from shore. Rescue operations were underway, and the names of 32 Indian tourists on board were released.
